body.x: KeyWe Studio(www.pleet.kr) introduced its people management app "Pleet" at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

Pleet is the people management app that tells the users who the person in front of them is. It connects through Bluetooth, and informs the users useful information like past encounters, hobbies, and interest. It even introduces to the users the people the users want to meet or the people that want to meet the users.
Profiles can be uploaded on it, and it connects with other SNS. It controls the amount of information the users want to reveal. By connecting to beacons, it can be used for displaying ads.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
